tests.focused: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_phase3_evaluation.py tests/test_public_history.py tests/test_data_quality_strengthened.py tests/test_cost_coverage_gate.py

evidence.stress_contract: Each row includes closed_trades, gross_pnl, fees, funding, spread, slippage, net_pnl, drawdown, promotion_status; rows assert closed_trades <= baseline.
evidence.statistics: Minimum sample returns NOT_EVIDENCED/MINIMUM_SAMPLE_NOT_MET; adequate samples expose expectancy/R, bootstrap CI, profit factor, drawdown/recovery, win-loss, tails, consecutive losses, stability, and concentration.
evidence.hypotheses: Independent registry validates all required mechanism/data/features/entry-exit/cost-edge/falsification/failure-mode/exclusion/OOS fields.

resource_guard.decision: sequential bounded execution; no parallel heavy jobs

limitations: Stress latency, partial-fill, participation, and stale-data rows use conservative deterministic cost/coverage proxies; they are not venue microstructure replays.
Baseline currently stores aggregate net trade PnLs, so statistics are descriptive and do not establish statistical significance.
Funding readiness is durably emitted on successful evaluator output; rejected evaluator runs retain the historical no-output contract while returning a rejection reason on stderr.
No public-network evaluation was performed in this phase.
next_gate: Independent review of stress semantics and public-history evaluation under an explicitly authorized later phase.
